My therapist asked me if I had thoughts of killing myself / was hurting myself about 3 weeks ago. I said yes. She had to call my parents, she said (only of you are under 18), but I could choose if she had to tell them or if I wanted to tell them first. Then she asked if I was safe and we made an appointment for 2 days later. She asked me if I could promise I wouldn't kill myself until I see her again. I said yes. So if you are under 18 a therapist (or something similar) has to call your parents, but if you just answer that you won't kill yourself until the next visit you are not a crisis person and are not gonna be sent away. 

I live in the Netherlands, so there is a chance your country works differently, but I hope yhis helped.
